subject: MSA / Order Form intake — clause owners, party details, and redline schedule
messages:
From: Mike Chen <mike@acmehealth.io>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 22 Dec 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MSA + Order form (drafts attached)

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for taking this on. Attaching our initial MSA and a rough Order Form (both drafts) — we flagged a few places inline that are likely to need conversation (data residency, SLA credits, and IP carveouts). We'd like to move quickly but want to align on responsibilities up front so redlines don't bounce.

High-level asks from procurement & legal:
- Confirm hosting residency options (we need US-only for PHI handling)
- Target SLA and credit language (90th percentile latency and 99.9% uptime)
- Data access and audit log retention (minimum 12 months)
- Exhibit A: list of subprocessors and infra regions

Attached: Acme_MSA_v1.pdf (annotated), OrderForm-Draft.xlsx

Can we get a proposed handoff: party sheet + clause owners, and a 3-business-day first-pass redline window? Also please include a single point of contact for security evidence requests.

Happy to hop on a quick call tomorrow afternoon PT if helpful.

Thanks,
Mike Chen
Director of IT Procurement
Acme Health

--
Attachment: Acme_MSA_v1.pdf (pdf, 1.2MB)
Attachment: OrderForm-Draft.xlsx (xlsx, 120KB)

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Mike Chen <mike@acmehealth.io>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 22 Dec 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: RE: MSA + Order form (drafts attached)

Mike — thanks for the clear asks and the annotated drafts. Looping in Kimberly (Legal) and Marissa (Onboarding/CS) so we can split responsibilities and hit your timeline. Below is a short intake plan so everyone knows who owns what and next steps.

Intake & redline plan (proposal)
- Party sheet (we'll populate): owner = Karthik (sales) — due EOD 12/22
- Security/compliance evidence requests & residency questions: owner = Kimberly (legal/security) — first review complete by 12/23
- Commercial redlines (price/billing/credits): owner = Marissa (CS/ops) — first-pass redlines by 12/23
- Technical/hosting clarifications: owner = Karthik + Eng response (we'll coordinate) — answers by 12/23
- First consolidated redline bundle (tracked PDF with comment log): target 12/24 (3 business days from receipt)

Quick notes on your asks:
- US-only residency for PHI: Kimberly, is this something we can document as an optional Exhibit with region pinning?
- SLA language: we typically propose SLA language with 99.9% uptime and tiered credits; we can surface a standard clause for you and mark any deviations.
- Audit log retention: default is 12 months in hosted offering — Kimberly pls confirm in writing.

Next steps (action items)
1) Karthik: I will upload the party-sheet template to Drive and drop the link here.
2) Kimberly: first pass on residency and audit log language by COB 12/23.
3) Marissa: prepare billing/contact cadence and redline the Order Form first-pass by COB 12/23.
4) Mike: please confirm procurement contact for contract signature and availability for a 30m call tomorrow (12/23) 10:00-12:00 PT or 14:00-16:00 PT.

Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cMSA-Acme (party sheet + working folder)
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/12345678

I attached an empty party-sheet-initial.csv for your convenience.

Thanks — I will coordinate the internal redline owners and follow up once Kimberly and Marissa have their first comments.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Phone: (415) 555-0173

--
Attachment: party-sheet-initial.csv (csv, 2KB)
